header.contentDescription: A neuron in 3D with a branching dendritic tree and an action potential travelling down the axon

drawTextAnchored.text: a cortical neuron takes input from up to ten thousand others and emits a single train
the spike does not get bigger with a stronger input - the rate does
a myelinated axon runs at 100 m/s, a bare one at about 1
It is a volume, not a diagram
the dendritic tree samples a region of tissue, which a flat drawing hides
a tree that collects and a cable that sends
